admission.justification: The two member obligations hold only together: the single location guard and the one-time whole-file upgrade jointly guarantee exactly one user settings file with no compatibility reader and no partial fallback.

guarantee: User settings live at the single standard user config location; the whole file moves there exactly once with metadata preserved, every current-line reader uses the same location guard, old-only and both-path states refuse, and the upgrade command adds no role-key-only fallback.
title: single-user-settings-path
